Who I am

About

I started in technical support handling Tier 2 network and connectivity issues for a major U.S. internet provider, then carried that troubleshooting discipline into a very different setting: the Bureau of Fire Protection, where I've spent the last seven years as both a firefighter and the office's ICT specialist.

That combination is unusual, but it works in one direction: emergency response teaches you to fix things under pressure with whatever is on hand, and IT support teaches you to fix things methodically so they stay fixed. I bring both to hardware and network troubleshooting, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration, and WordPress site management.

I also run OBS Studio for live streaming BFP–Negros Island Region programs and public events, and support ICT procurement and BAC documentation for my office. Alongside all of this, I freelance as a remote technical support specialist for international clients, and I'm now looking to bring this full skill set into a full-time IT Support, Helpdesk, or Technical Coordinator role in the UAE.
